name: Grand tour projection visualization — Daniel Asimov, 1985
summary: Asimov's 1985 grand tour visualizes multivariate statistical data through orthogonal projections onto a sequence of two-dimensional subspaces chosen to be dense in the space of all such subspaces.
source_title: The Grand Tour: A Tool for Viewing Multidimensional Data
caveat: Density means approaching every projection subspace arbitrarily closely, not exhaustively viewing all projections in finitely many steps. The repository's sampled Givens rotations do not establish grand-tour convergence or implement projection pursuit. Angular catalog coincidences cannot establish natural causes.
